assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All boundaries (site, key areas, constraints) are provisional geometry from the site package.
assumptions.impact: All area metrics and derived layers support intake display only and must be recomputed after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: The 51 concept masses and their footprints are design quantities generated by the concept pipeline, not statutory build-out.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, and intensity metrics are recorded as unknown; massing informs character and phasing only.

assumptions.statement: Scenario-card operations (data pipelines, privacy safeguards, review workflows, operating bodies) are concept designs.
assumptions.impact: Each scenario requires legal, privacy, and safety review with the named operating body before deployment.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, branding, attraction, and long-term operations are concept suggestions, not confirmed government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: Event and operations content illustrates intent and awaits confirmation by responsible agencies.

assumptions.statement: Juesheng Temple (Dazhongsi) protection ranges and the railway heritage corridor boundaries follow official designation.
assumptions.impact: Heritage-adjacent heights and the protection belt (CT-001/CT-002) are conservative concepts pending official determination.
